cases.prompt: Upgrade express from 4.19.2 to 5.1.0 in package.json, with package-lock.json committed and npm as package manager. The express 5 migration notes say app.del() is removed and path-to-regexp v8 changes wildcard syntax so "/*" must be named, for example "/*splat". src/routes/files.ts uses app.get('/files/*', handler) and src/routes/admin.ts uses app.del('/cache', clear).
sourceAnchors: Plan and apply a dependency upgrade from release evidence, compatibility surface, migration steps, and rollback.
Keep dependency changes reproducible and block explicit package-manager safety bypasses.

requiredEvidence: the wildcard route in src/routes/files.ts must be renamed
app.del in src/routes/admin.ts must become app.delete
